title: TIN OF WATCHES
findings: Ten ladies' and unisex quartz fashion watches. One black-dial gold-tone round watch reads 'Christian Dior' (looks like the classic vintage Dior quartz, possibly genuine). A dual-dial rectangular steel watch reads 'CARTIER' but the design is not a Cartier model, almost certainly a fake. Others include gold-tone Roman dial with crown logo (fashion brand), tank-style square, two-tone bracelet watches and a stone-set bezel watch, unbranded or illegible fashion brands.
condition: Used, wear to leather straps; running state unknown; batteries likely flat.
reason: Mixed fashion watches but includes a possibly genuine vintage Christian Dior ladies quartz.

interest.note: Tin of 10 quartz fashion watches; one possible genuine vintage Christian Dior black dial; 'Cartier' dual-time is almost certainly fake.

title: MOORCROFT FRAMED EMBOSSED PRINT - LA GARENNE

reason: Moorcroft-branded decorative print, low resale value.

title: COLIN PARKER OIL ON BOARD - AN OLD PEPPERCORN - SIGNED LOWER LEFT
findings: Oil on board of a large old peppercorn tree over timber stockyard rails, loose plein-air style, signed lower left 'COLIN PARKER' (read in crop). Colin Parker is an established Victorian landscape painter whose oils regularly sell at auction; style and subject consistent with his work.
condition: Appears sound; frame with minor wear and marks.
reason: Signed oil by established Australian landscape painter Colin Parker; signature reads correctly.

title: SIGNED WATERCOLOUR - THE RAPIDS - SIGNED LOWER LEFT
findings: Watercolour of a river rapids in a hilly valley, in traditional British late 19th or early 20th century style. Signed lower left in two lines but signature illegible even enlarged. Could be a period British watercolour.
condition: Some foxing or discolouration possible; framed under glass with glare.
reason: Period-looking signed watercolour, signature unreadable; worth an inspection to identify artist.

title: NORMAN LINDSAY PLATE 41 FROM HIS 1977 FAVOURITE ETCHINGS BOOK - VIRTUE
findings: Norman Lindsay 'Virtue' reproduction plate (plate 41) removed from the 1977 'Favourite Etchings' book, framed. Book plate reproduction, not an original etching; no pencil signature.
reason: Book plate reproduction, not an original Lindsay etching.
